memory_lessons.applicability: Performance of a standalone arithmetic transformation does not establish its interaction with the SIMD and recurrence optimizations in G.
memory_lessons.claim: G candidate 1e97ac568500465d measured correct at 0.018706 s; the standalone FMA trial 31c053d9f320458b was correct but measured 0.304291 s. The combined result must be measured independently.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Compare the integrated FMA candidate with 1e97ac568500465d on the controller’s varied correctness cases and whole-call timing.

proposal.hypothesis: Applying the explicit fused multiply-add from the valid T3 trial to G’s SIMD rollback may reduce per-state arithmetic cost, though T3 was slower in isolation and the interaction remains unmeasured. This may also alter rounding, so controller correctness checks are essential.

retained: Retained G’s lane-contiguous batches, double-precision terminal recurrence, hoisted transition weights, rollback order, and thread-budget-aware dispatch.
Adapted the T3 fused rollback arithmetic by using fmaf(downWeight, V[k], upWeight * V[k + 1]) across SIMD lanes; left the controller to check rounding tolerance and full-call performance.
